## Database Management
- The database schema should exclude the following tables: Suppliers, PurchaseOrders, TicketParts, or StockMovements.
- The DatabaseManagementWindow should not create the aforementioned tables.
- Remove VendorId from the Parts schema.

## DataGrid Formatting
- Center-align text in all DataGrid cells and headers across the application (both horizontally and vertically).
